description: Declares a modern SQLAlchemy 2.0 ORM model class using Mapped type annotations and mapped_column.
template:
class {{table_class_name}}(Base):
    __tablename__ = "{{table_name}}"

    id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, primary_key=True, autoincrement=True)
    {{column_name}}: Mapped[{{column_type}}] = mapped_column({{column_sql_type}}, nullable=False)
